title.zh-TW: 輝達董事會恢復黃仁勳執行長職務，股價單日飆漲31%
title.en: Nvidia board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO; shares jump 31% in a day

summary.zh-TW: 中央社報導，輝達董事會一致決議即日起恢復黃仁勳總裁、執行長及董事職務，稱已徵詢美方高層、不構成國安風險；獨立董事對相關情報疑慮的調查仍持續。美股23日收盤輝達漲31.48%至165.05美元，費半漲14.03%、那斯達克漲6.51%、標普漲4.73%，美光、戴爾等AI相關股同步大漲。
summary.en: CNA reports Nvidia's board unanimously reinstated Jensen Huang as president, CEO and director, saying it consulted senior US officials and sees no national-security risk; an independent-director probe continues. On Nov. 23 Nvidia closed up 31.48% at US$165.05, the SOX rose 14.03%, the Nasdaq 6.51% and the S&P 500 4.73%, with Micron and Dell also surging.

impact.zh-TW: 執行面不確定性下降帶動AI股報復性反彈，但內部調查、出口管制合規與週三PCE數據及12月可能升息仍在，單日大漲後波動可能延續。以上為市場推論。
impact.en: Lower leadership uncertainty sparked a sharp AI rebound, but the internal probe, export-control compliance, Wednesday's PCE data and a possible December hike remain; volatility may persist after the jump. Market inference.

title.zh-TW: 行政院將檢討擴大國安基金規模，產業稱AI訂單看到2029年
title.en: Taiwan to review expanding stabilization fund; industry cites AI order visibility to 2029

summary.zh-TW: 行政院長卓榮泰23日召集產業與金融代表，表示國安基金能量仍有餘裕，但將正面檢討規模；財長稱基金動用上限5,000億元自2000年未調整，立法院已排審修法草案。金管會已限制平盤下放空。經濟部長轉述業界稱部分AI訂單能見度至2029年，但補充既有訂單約至2027年消化。
summary.en: On Nov. 23 Premier Cho Jung-tai said the National Stabilization Fund still has capacity but its size will be reviewed. The finance minister said its NT$500bn cap is unchanged since 2000 and lawmakers have a draft amendment. Short-selling below the prior close is restricted. The economy minister relayed AI order visibility to 2029, adding current orders run to about 2027.

impact.zh-TW: 政策信號有助穩定信心，加權指數23日漲約780點；但擴大規模仍需修法，訂單能見度屬業界說法，不等於已確認營收。
impact.en: The policy signal may steady sentiment; the TAIEX rose about 780 points on Nov. 23. But expansion needs legislation, and order visibility is an industry claim, not confirmed revenue.

title.zh-TW: 台積電罕見表態：AI需求成長，先進製程產能持續吃緊
title.en: TSMC says AI demand is growing and advanced-node capacity remains tight

summary.zh-TW: 中央社報導，台積電23日表示全球AI需求持續成長、長期看好，先進製程需求強勁且產能供不應求；需求正由聊天機器人轉向AI助理與代理式AI。公司也提到零組件漲價與總經不確定性對消費性及價格敏感市場構成挑戰。聲明未提供具體數字。
summary.en: CNA reports TSMC said on Nov. 23 that global AI demand keeps growing, its long-term view is positive, and advanced-node demand exceeds capacity, as use shifts from chatbots to AI assistants and agentic AI. It flagged component price rises and macro uncertainty as challenges for consumer and price-sensitive markets. No figures were given.

impact.zh-TW: 在美國管制與輝達人事風波後，公司說法可緩和市場對AI需求的疑慮；但屬質化表述，後續仍需以月營收與法說會數據驗證。
impact.en: After US export rules and the Nvidia turmoil, the comments may ease AI-demand worries, but they are qualitative and need confirmation from monthly sales and earnings data.

title.zh-TW: 金價連跌五日後反彈，盤中一度大漲4.2%
title.en: Gold rebounds after five-day slide, rising as much as 4.2% intraday

summary.zh-TW: 經濟日報報導，金價連五跌至逾一年低點後，23日低接買盤進場，現貨金一度漲4.2%至每盎司3,686.42美元，銅價同步上揚。上週金價跌約9%，為3月以來最大週跌幅；較1月高點5,595美元已回落約37%。瑞銀19日將2026年底目標下調至4,500美元。
summary.en: Economic Daily News reports bargain buyers lifted gold on Nov. 23 after five straight declines to a more-than-one-year low; spot gold rose as much as 4.2% to US$3,686.42/oz and copper also gained. Gold fell about 9% last week, its worst since March, and is about 37% below January's US$5,595 record. UBS cut its end-2026 target to US$4,500 on Nov. 19.

impact.zh-TW: 反彈反映風險情緒回穩與低接買盤；分析師提醒12月可能升息與實質利率上升仍壓抑短線，央行購金為長線支撐，看法分歧。
impact.en: The bounce reflects steadier risk appetite and bargain hunting. Analysts note a possible December hike and higher real yields may cap the short term, while central-bank buying supports the long run; views differ.

title.zh-TW: OpenAI首席科學家倡議以困惑度設定業界AI發展門檻
title.en: OpenAI chief scientist proposes perplexity thresholds to cap frontier AI

summary.zh-TW: 中央社引述路透報導，OpenAI首席科學家Jakub Pachocki發文建議AI開發者以「困惑度」作為共同指標，在監控能力達到共識標準前承諾不跨越約定門檻；他預估AI輔助訓練最快2027年可能突破。執行長奧特曼在X上表態支持。此為提議，尚非業界共識或法規。
summary.en: CNA, citing Reuters, reports OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki proposed developers use perplexity as a shared metric and pledge not to cross agreed thresholds until monitoring meets an agreed standard; he expects AI-assisted training could break through as early as 2027. CEO Sam Altman backed it on X. It is a proposal, not an industry agreement or rule.

impact.zh-TW: 若形成業界自律門檻，可能影響前沿模型擴張節奏與算力需求預期；目前僅為倡議，對資本支出的實際影響尚不明確。
impact.en: If adopted as an industry norm, thresholds could affect the pace of frontier-model scaling and compute-demand expectations; for now it is only a proposal with unclear capex impact.

reason.zh-TW: 報導直接引述台積電稱AI需求成長、先進製程供不應求；其美國存託憑證在輝達大漲當日漲14.1%。
reason.en: Reports directly cite TSMC saying AI demand is growing and advanced nodes are tight; its ADR rose 14.1% on the day Nvidia surged.

risk.zh-TW: 美國晶片出口管制擴大、AI評價波動、零組件漲價壓抑終端需求。
risk.en: Wider US chip export controls, AI valuation swings and component cost increases curbing end demand.

reason.zh-TW: 董事長劉揚偉以電電公會理事長身分出席行政院會議；鴻海為輝達AI伺服器重要組裝夥伴，輝達領導層回穩可能影響供應鏈情緒。屬產業推論。
reason.en: Chairman Young Liu attended the Cabinet meeting as an industry association head; Foxconn is a key Nvidia AI server assembler, so steadier Nvidia leadership may affect supply-chain sentiment. Industry inference.

risk.zh-TW: 輝達內部調查結果、出口管制、伺服器毛利與出貨時程變化。
risk.en: Outcome of Nvidia's probe, export controls, server margins and shipment timing.

reason.zh-TW: 美股伺服器與雲端股隨輝達反彈大漲（戴爾漲20.5%）；廣達為AI伺服器代工廠，業界稱訂單能見度延伸。屬產業推論。
reason.en: US server and cloud names rallied with Nvidia (Dell +20.5%); Quanta builds AI servers and industry cites extended order visibility. Industry inference.

risk.zh-TW: 雲端資本支出放緩、訂單能見度未轉化為營收、零組件成本上升。
risk.en: Slower cloud capex, order visibility not turning into revenue, rising component costs.

reason.zh-TW: 美光於輝達回升當日漲19%，記憶體股對AI情緒敏感；南亞科為台灣DRAM廠，可能受同類情緒牽動。屬產業推論。
reason.en: Micron rose 19% as Nvidia rebounded, showing memory stocks' sensitivity to AI sentiment; Nanya, a Taiwan DRAM maker, may see similar swings. Industry inference.

risk.zh-TW: 記憶體報價循環、AI情緒反轉與12月可能升息。
risk.en: Memory price cycle, a reversal in AI sentiment and a possible December rate hike.

reason.zh-TW: 董事長蔡明興出席行政院穩市會議；國安基金規模檢討、放空與融資規定調整直接影響股市資金環境，金控投資部位與證券業務相關。
reason.en: Chairman Tsai Ming-hsing attended the Cabinet market meeting; the fund review and short-selling and margin rule changes shape equity-market liquidity tied to financial groups' holdings and brokerage.

risk.zh-TW: 股市續跌造成投資評價損失、利率與匯率波動、修法時程不確定。
risk.en: Further equity declines hurting valuations, rate and FX swings, uncertain amendment timing.
